hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; m="$d/.claude/.drift-checked"; if [ -f "$m" ]; then n=$(find "$d/CLAUDE.md" "$d/docs" "$d/skills" "$d/.claude/agents" -type f -newer "$m" 2>/dev/null | head -1); else n=$(find "$d/CLAUDE.md" "$d/docs" "$d/skills" "$d/.claude/agents" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if [ -n "$n" ]; then printf "%s" "{\"systemMessage\":\"Docs or agent definitions changed since the last recorded drift check. Consider running the drift-checker agent; then run: touch .claude/.drift-checked\"}"; fi
